messages:
Liam T: Hi all  first morning. Enrolled my M1 Mac via the company DEP flow but when I try to install an internal .pkg from our S3 bucket I get Gatekeeper errors: "The operation couldn't be completed. (OSStatus error -67010.)" and "Package not signed by a developer Apple can identify." Jamf Self Service won't install it either, shows "installation failed". Any tips?

Harper (IT): welcome @Liam T :wave: that error is Gatekeeper refusing an unsigned/notarized installer. Quick questions: which macOS version? Also can you run `spctl -a -vv /path/to/your.pkg` and paste output? Jamf can push a signed/notarized build or we can add a notarized installer to Self Service.

Liam T: macOS 13.5.1 (M1). `spctl -a -vv ~/Downloads/internal-tool.pkg` returns `rejected: source=Developer ID` and `origin=Developer ID Application: OurCorp (TEAMID)`. Looks like signature present but not notarized?

Harper (IT): that output suggests it was signed but Gatekeeper wants notarization stapled. For M1 macs notarization is required for some installer types. Two options: 1) I can push the notarized PKG through Jamf as a policy (no user interaction). 2) Temporarily disable Gatekeeper for testing (`sudo spctl --master-disable`) but we avoid that for security. We prefer Jamf push. Do you have the package URL or artifact name?

Liam T: artifact path s3://redwood-artifacts/internal-tool/0.9.1/internal-tool.pkg. Would appreciate a push; I don't have admin to staple or re-notarize.

Nina (People Ops): tagging IT  welcome Liam! IT normally handles artifact pushes during onboarding. If push will take longer than 2 hours let us know.

Harper (IT): please paste your Hardware UUID (About This Mac -> System Report -> Hardware UUID) or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | awk '/Hardware UUID/ {print $3}'` so I can target the Jamf policy. Also confirm you don't need the tool immediately (we can schedule during low-usage).

Liam T: UUID: 4f3e2d1c-0a9b-4cde-8f12-abcdef123456. I don't need it in the next hour.

Jamf Bot: Policy "Install notarized internal-tool 0.9.1" queued for device 4f3e2d1c-0a9b-4cde-8f12-abcdef123456. Estimated completion: ~4 minutes.

Harper (IT): pushed notarized package to Self Service and queued a targeted install. You should see a Jamf toast; reboot not required. Try opening the package from Self Service or /Applications after install.

Liam T: got the toast, Self Service shows "Install succeeded". I launched the app and no Gatekeeper prompt. Thank you!

Nina (People Ops): great onboarding win :tada: welcome to Redwood!

Liam T: all set, closing thread.
